title: Base64 encoding and decoding at almost the speed of a memory copy
key_contribution: Showed AVX-512 VBMI base64 decode approaches memcpy speed, generating several times fewer instructions than previous SIMD codecs, establishing the upper bound for current hardware.

title: For SIMD workload performance increase of AVX512 over AVX2 is 2x (HN discussion)
key_contribution: Community discussion of AVX-512 vs AVX2 real-world scaling, including frequency throttling effects and workload-dependent gains.

title: Turbo-Base64: Fastest Base64 SIMD (GitHub repository)
key_contribution: Claims to be faster than memcpy for Base64 encode/decode across SSE/AVX2/AVX512/NEON/Altivec, providing benchmark data across multiple ISA widths.

title: eXmY: A Data Type and Technique for Arbitrary Bit Precision Quantization
key_contribution: Demonstrated SIMD-optimized encoding/decoding for non-power-of-two bit widths across CPU and GPU, showing how vector width affects codec throughput for arbitrary formats.
